Detail: Research evidence pack: observed numeric tables are separated from category taxonomy.
Raw_Size_Observations contains only figures extracted from cited source results.
A size label is not universal. Finished/flat garment charts and body charts are not comparable without conversion.
Confirmed = category/offer verified; Measured = a numeric chart exists; Proposed = valid configurable category but no verified universal numeric chart included.
Import Categories.csv and Measurement_Keys.csv. Store Raw_Size_Observations.csv as evidence, not as universal defaults.
Fabric-cut products use metres/width, never XS-XXL.
Public sites often use JavaScript/product-level tables; this pack records only verifiable retrieved data and flags limits.
